page_note: Heavily ecclesial page. Two units: (1) continuation of teaching about why no apocalypse is given to the elect — they are tied up as wage-laborers in the world (hortatory/ecclesial register throughout); (2) Kephalaion 103 'Concerning the five marvelous works which the Mind of Light produces in the elect' — a five-fold enumeration (Wisdom, Faith, [?], Love, Patience) of inner virtues. The enumeration STRUCTURE is substratic (Mind of Light producing five kinds, ordinal markers), but every iteration is wrapped in ecclesial application ('in the elect', 'in the church', 'the brothers and sisters seated in his midst'). Editorial fatigue score is negative because the chapter heading concentrates ecclesial vocabulary in the first half. Damage ratio 69.7% makes some segments fragmentary. Where possible I extract the bare enumeration markers + virtue names as substrate, and treat the ecclesial elaboration as overlay.
